More Than a Place at the Table.

Discover a space where flavour, atmosphere, and good company come together.

Behind a sculpted entrance on Zahoor Elahi Road, a long counter glows softly above a floor of green-and-white tile — a room made for lingering over sushi, grills, pizza and something sweet to finish.
